value.rationale: The cut-family inverse-design problem is explicitly proposed as open-ended future work by Mirsohi. This resolves its naturally symmetric seven-party/seven-triple instance completely, including all optimizers and a sharp, dimension-explicit variance improvement over planar cyclic monitoring; for \(p=2\) the ratio is 557/385. This finite design classification is physically interpretable and is not only a recomputation of a table entry. It does not claim a new general covariance identity or universal design construction.
